name: linkguard
description: Browser extension that flags scam, phishing and dangerous links and stops dangerous sites before they open.

scripts.lint: node scripts/build.mjs firefox && web-ext lint --source-dir dist/firefox
scripts.start:chrome: node scripts/build.mjs chrome && web-ext run --target chromium --source-dir dist/chrome
scripts.start:firefox: node scripts/build.mjs firefox && web-ext run --source-dir dist/firefox
scripts.start:android: node scripts/build.mjs firefox && web-ext run --target firefox-android --source-dir dist/firefox
scripts.package: node scripts/build.mjs && web-ext build --source-dir dist/chrome --artifacts-dir dist --filename linkguard-chrome.zip --overwrite-dest && web-ext build --source-dir dist/firefox --artifacts-dir dist --filename linkguard-firefox.zip --overwrite-dest
scripts.sign:firefox: node scripts/build.mjs firefox && web-ext sign --source-dir dist/firefox --channel unlisted
scripts.safari: node scripts/build.mjs safari && xcrun safari-web-extension-converter dist/safari --project-location safari --app-name LinkGuard --bundle-identifier com.example.linkguard --swift --copy-resources --no-open --no-prompt --force
